_comment: COMMITTED. The two tracks of work for this project. Each item: {id, title, status(planned|active|done|blocked), start, updated, outcome, overview?, sessions[], researchRef?, reportRef?, reportHtml?}. `outcome` = one-line result (markdown spans OK). `overview` = a short markdown summary shown at the top of the detail view. `sessions` = agent-session ids (appended automatically by classify_session.mjs — additive; hand-edits preserved). `researchRef` (research track) points a round at a data/*.json research report. `reportRef` = a repo-relative .md file whose contents build_portal_data.mjs inlines (as reportMd) and the portal renders as a rich report. Files created/changed are derived automatically from each session's tool calls. NOTE: this file is hand-maintained — when a new unit of work happens, add/update an item here so the portal reflects it (the hook regenerates the portal FROM this file but never invents items).

items.title: Read the Google Docs + clone the web-app; sharpen the plan
items.outcome: Pulled the planning doc + the workshop setup-guide (via the Google Workspace MCP) and vendored the reference web app into `web-app/`. **Use case, deployment, and flow are now concrete** — GOALS.md updated.
items.overview:
Ingested two Google Docs and a reference repo, then re-grounded the plan on real decisions:

- **Use case = Employee Agent V1** (meeting-note agent: ingest notes/transcript → log to a Notes record, summarize, create tasks, draft email). Maps to the `Note_taking_agent` already in `force-app/`.
- **Deployment = package-based** (install link), **not** browser-OAuth — a firm decision to avoid security warnings / participant anxiety. `AiAuthoringBundle` still isn't packageable, so the package ships everything *around* the agent and the attendee builds it in Agent Studio.
- **Workshop flow (decided):** Part A guided (instructions → add Note + Summarize actions → preview → commit → test) + Part B free exercise (draft email, Query Records, Search Web, fetch tasks, image/voice).
- **Backup = a free pre-configured org** for anyone whose primary org fails.
- **Web app** vendored into `web-app/` from `flemx/vibe-code-agenforce-claude` (Vite+React; content in `MainContent.jsx`) — to be re-scripted to our flow (see `web-app/NOTES.md`).

items.title: Lightning app + LWC launchpad + unlocked package (G1/G2/G3)
items.outcome: Shipped as an **unlocked package** (`Employee Agent Workshop 0.1.0.1`, `04tWt000000GDJ3IAO`) built from the `hackathon` DevHub and **installed + browser-verified in `hackathon_sandbox`**: the app loads, **Run Setup** assigns all perm sets, the launchpad shows "Setup complete." Fixed three real bugs found via agent-browser (missing tab, broken `AFDX_User_Perms` group, namespaced perm-set lookup) and removed scaffold junk. All **13 Apex tests pass**.
items.overview:
The starting point of the workshop — what the install lands in. **Package-based by decision** (avoids browser-OAuth security warnings); ships everything *around* the agent (the agent is built in-org because `AiAuthoringBundle` isn't packageable).

**Built this session:**
- **`Employee_Agent_Workshop` Lightning app** + **`Employee_Agent_Workshop_Home`** App-page (FlexiPage) + tab — the launchpad surface.
- **`workshopLaunchpad` LWC** — welcome hero, **Open the workshop guide** link, and a **Run Setup** button with live per-item status (SLDS, accessible, idempotent re-runs).
- **`WorkshopSetupController`** (`@AuraEnabled`) — assigns the configured permission sets / groups to `UserInfo.getUserId()` idempotently with partial-success DML; **setup-object DML only, so no mixed-DML risk** (validated by the feasibility research). Built-in Apex defaults (`Employee_Agent_Workshop` PS + `AFDX_User_Perms` PSG + `Note_taking_agent`) so it works on a clean install with **no** custom-metadata record.
- **`Workshop_Settings__mdt`** type (5 fields) as an **optional point-and-click override** for the guide/install URLs.
- **`Employee_Agent_Workshop`** permission set (package-safe: no `agentAccesses` to the not-yet-built agent).

**Gotcha found & worked around:** deploying a Custom Metadata *record with values* via the CLI throws an opaque `UNKNOWN_EXCEPTION` on these orgs (reproduces for a brand-new throwaway CMDT type; a skeleton record with no values deploys fine). Fix: real defaults live in **Apex**, the record is an optional Setup-edited override moved to `docs/optional-metadata/` so a full-source deploy / package build never breaks.

**Packaged & browser-tested (2026-06-11):** decided **unlocked package**, built `Employee Agent Workshop 0.1.0.1` (`04tWt000000GDJ3IAO`) from the `hackathon` DevHub and installed it into `hackathon_sandbox`. Tested the running app with **agent-browser** and fixed three real bugs: (1) the **Home tab** had been rolled back by an earlier failed multi-component deploy + the perm set lacked tab visibility → redeployed the tab and added `tabSettings`; (2) **Run Setup** referenced the broken scaffold group `AFDX_User_Perms` → switched to assigning the **standard OOB perm sets** (`force__EinsteinGPTPromptTemplateUser`, `force__CopilotSalesforceUser`) + `Employee_Agent_Workshop`; (3) **namespaced perm-set lookup** (`WHERE Name='force__…'` matched nothing) → strip/rederive the namespace. Removed scaffold junk (`Resort_*`, `AFDX_*`, weather Apex, `Get_Event_Info`, `Get_Resort_Hours`, `Local_Info_Agent`) and `.forceignore`d `aiAuthoringBundles`. Verified end-to-end in the sandbox: app loads, Run Setup → all perms assigned, accelerator → agent published+activated.

**Next:** the action assets (Note Flow + Summarize prompt template) in the asset library; finalize the agent starter; set the real guide/install URLs.

items.title: Browser-side agent deploy accelerator (NGA Connect API) — stretch G2
items.outcome: Proved — and shipped — a one-click **deploy → publish → activate** of the Agent Script agent from the browser, using the internal **Next-Gen Authoring Connect API**. End-to-end verified live on `hackathon_sb` (Bot created + activated) via the `NextGenAgentDeployer` Apex; **12/12 tests pass**, deployer coverage 86%.
items.overview:
The stretch accelerator from G2, now real. `AiAuthoringBundle` can't be packaged and `sf agent publish` is CLI-only — but the internal **Next-Gen Authoring Connect API** (`/services/data/v64.0/nextgen-authoring/...`, found via code search of the OpenAPI spec) lets us do it from an in-org callout.

**How it works:**
- **`NextGenAgentDeployer`** (Apex) reads the Agent Script from a **Static Resource** (`Note_taking_agent_afscript`), rewrites its `developer_name`/`agent_label` to the requested apiName, then calls **create → publish → activate** and assigns the agent-access perm set — all server-side.
- **`NextGenAgentDeployerSession`** (Visualforce, `{!$Api.Session_ID}`) supplies an **API-enabled session** (the Lightning/LWC session isn't reliably API-enabled; a self-callout to the org My Domain needs no Remote Site Setting).
- **`agentDeployButton`** LWC — an *optional, clearly-marked* "deploy the agent for me" button on the launchpad Home page (for the backup org / stuck attendees; the main path is still build-it-in-Studio).

**Gotchas found & fixed (see `docs/reference/nextgen-authoring-connect-api.md`):** live path has **no `/connect/`** segment; the runtime BotDefinition name comes from `developer_name` *inside* the afscript (collision → `DUPLICATE_VALUE`, fixed by rewriting it); activate returns 204; published agents can't be fully API-deleted.

**Decision:** ship it as an internal accelerator, NOT the customer happy-path — the endpoint is undocumented (fragile) and auto-publishing would remove Part A's learning.

items.title: Note-capture suite: audio/file/text → agent, HTML notes, note viewer
items.outcome: Built & sandbox-verified 4 components: **noteCapture** LWC (record audio → speech-to-text, drag files → image-to-text via prompt template, paste text → send to a chosen Employee Agent via the ACC API), **HtmlNoteService** (richly-formatted ContentNote from HTML, 8/8 tests), **noteViewer** LWC + controller (read-only HTML render + Download-PDF, 3/3), and the **NoteCaptureController/AI** backends (4/4 each). All 27 Apex tests pass; the HTML-note round-trip is verified live.
items.overview:
A richer capture + notes experience around the agent.

- **`noteCapture` LWC** — three input paths (animated audio recorder → `convertBase64SpeechToText`; multi-file drag → multimodal prompt template `ConnectApi.EinsteinLLM.generateMessagesForPromptTemplate`, parallel; pasted text), combined and sent to a chosen Employee Agent via `lightning/accApi` (open + execute).
- **`HtmlNoteService`** (Apex + `@InvocableMethod`) — creates a formatted `ContentNote` (HTML in a Blob, sanitized to an allowed-tag whitelist), links to a record. Unlocks polished meeting summaries + a workshop-report deliverable.
- **`noteViewer` LWC + `NoteViewerController`** — lists notes, renders HTML read-only via `lightning-formatted-rich-text`, Download-PDF via a print window.
- **Backends:** `NoteCaptureController` (ContentVersion upload, Employee-Agent listing), `NoteCaptureAI` (speech-to-text + prompt template, graceful degradation when AI is off).

**Packaging decision:** these depend on org features (`ContentNote`, `ConnectApi.EinsteinLLM`, `BotDefinition`) absent from the vanilla 2GP build org, so they're kept in **`feature-addons/`** and deployed directly (own `Employee_Agent_Notes_Addon` perm set) — the core package stays clean. Verified end-to-end in `hackathon_sandbox`; report at `docs/component-test-report.html`.

items.overview:
The agent's capabilities, shipped in the package's asset library so attendees just **add** them — no building from scratch.

- **Part A (required):** **Log/Create Note** (Flow — already `First_Agent_Log_Account_Note`) + **Summarize** (Prompt Template).

items.title: What's packageable for Agentforce + browser-side deploy / perm-assignment path
items.outcome: **Confirmed:** perm-set assignment from `@AuraEnabled` Apex is the reliable browser-triggered path (setup-object DML only → no mixed-DML); **runtime publish of the `AiAuthoringBundle` from the browser is NOT viable** — publishing is CLI/Studio-only (no Apex/REST entry point), and `UserInfo.getSessionId()` is intentionally not API-enabled in Lightning. So: LWC button does perm-set assignment; attendee builds the agent in Agent Studio.
items.overview:
Source-cited feasibility investigation (background subagent, 2026-06-11) into doing config/deploy **from the browser**:

- **Perm-set assignment (✅ green light):** `Database.insert(new PermissionSetAssignment(AssigneeId=UserInfo.getUserId(), PermissionSetId=…))` from `@AuraEnabled` Apex; look up by `Name` (PS) / `DeveloperName` (PSG); idempotent by checking existing assignments; **no mixed-DML** as long as only setup-object DML runs in the transaction (HIGH confidence).
- **Runtime `AiAuthoringBundle` deploy/publish (❌ not viable):** publishing an Agent Script bundle is a CLI/Studio-only compile step (`sf agent publish`) with no public Apex/REST endpoint; the MD-API-from-Apex path is blocked because the Lightning-context `UserInfo.getSessionId()` is deliberately **not** API-enabled (Visualforce-page session is the only workaround). Deploying the bundle *source* only stages a DRAFT — it doesn't create the live Bot/BotVersion.
- **What IS packageable:** perm sets/groups (incl. `agentAccesses`), Apex, Flows, `GenAiPromptTemplate`, Lightning app + Home page + LWC, custom objects/fields, and `BotTemplate` (Bot-based agents). **NOT** `AiAuthoringBundle`.
- **Net:** the package ships supporting assets; the LWC launchpad assigns perms; the attendee builds & publishes Employee Agent V1 in Agent Studio. (Optionally auto-activate a published BotVersion via the Connect REST `bot-versions/{id}/activation` endpoint, server-side.)

This directly validated the **`build-package-assets`** architecture.
